claims.statement: For independent cap-one X,Y and nondegenerate indefinite q=ax^2+bxy+cy^2 with d=sqrt(b^2-4ac), p_q(u)<=2^(7/4)sqrt(3)d^(-3/4)|u|^(-1/4) a.e. u!=0.
For an invertible indefinite original-coordinate pair B, D=|det B|, after exact pair completion with remainder R, ||p_Q||_inf<=2sqrt(3)D^(-3/8)sup_t E|t-R|^(-1/4).
In exact rank three with third scale s, an invertible indefinite physical pair of determinant magnitude D gives ||p_Q||_inf<=4sqrt(30)D^(-3/8)s^(-1/4), removing sigma_min(B).

For three independent cap-one original coordinates and any invertible symmetric 3x3 M with arbitrary affine term, ||p_Q||_inf<=16*2^(1/4)*sqrt(30)|det M|^(-1/3). Ambient conditioning preserves the same bound for an original-coordinate principal triple.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: ||p_(h dot X)||_inf<=sqrt(e), yielding ||p_Q||_inf<=8sqrt(3)e^(1/4)D^(-3/8)s^(-1/4) in the no-extra-transverse-affine rank-one remainder subcase
